ld_structure: identity (same independent-SNP contract for both methods)
fairness: exposure-only weights for the external score
method-specific estimands; undefined target cells are not scored as bias or coverage

scenarios.constant_null_directional_pleiotropy: MR-GxE causal target is zero; PlantMR environment slope is not scored because pleiotropy makes it non-causal.
scenarios.constant_effect_no_pleiotropy: Both methods have a defined causal/heterogeneity target under no pleiotropy.
scenarios.constant_effect_directional_pleiotropy: MR-GxE is designed for constant causal effect plus constant pleiotropy; PlantMR slope is diagnostic, not a causal target.
scenarios.environment_effect_heterogeneity: PlantMR has a defined environment slope; summary MR-GxE invariant-effect target is not scored.
